tei:div.tei:p: tshe ring mched lnga'i bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ sngon tshe padma thod phreng bka'// bar du bzhad pa rdo rje'i lung*// tha mar 'jigs pa med pa'i gtam// nyon cig tshe ring mched lnga po// khyod kyi dam bca' gang zhe na// ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la// gsang sngags 'chad nyan spel gsum gyi// bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// gnod byed dgra bgegs gzhom par chad// sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong zhes gsung*// dam bca'i dus la deng babs kyi// bskul lo drag po'i thugs dam bskul// rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung ba// srung ma khyed kyis ma dgongs sam// rgyugs shig dmigs pa'i dgra la rgyugs// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan pa// mgo bskor lam bsgyur dgra zlar sprod// tshe bstung srog gcod dpal g.yang phrogs// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring la// drag shul 'khrugs 'khrugs rngams pa'i gzugs// 'khor du lha mo rnam bzhi dang*// bod skyong gzhi bdag thams cad kun// dgra bo gnod byed (444)steng du rgyug /bskul pa yin no myur du rgyug /rbad pa yin no dgra bo sod// bcol pa yin no las kun sgrubs// dgra la mthu rtags mngon sum ston// gal ste de lta mi byed na// dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes chad kyis/ khyod kyang 'og nas 'og tu lhung*// bdag kyang dgras brnyas nor mi thub// bstan srung gtam yang ming tsam gyur// kye ma kyi hud dam can ma// ma g.yel bdag gi nor phyir rgyugs// bcol pa'i las kun myur 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'ang lag na rdo rjes smras so// dge'o/// /
